sentence: This project builds a treatment from an artificial virus made from bacteriophage T4 that gives stem cells resistance to HIV infection.
This project sets up a shared lab that helps study trained immunity in transplantation by profiling immune cells and handling bioinformatics analyses.
This project uses single-cell tools and serum proteomics to measure immune responses to vaccination in blood and tissue samples.
This project studies the genes and epigenome of multiple myeloma to learn how the disease behaves and evolves over time.
This project improves optical coherence tomography angiography, an imaging method that shows blood vessels in the retina.
This project builds an autonomous evolution system that makes affinity reagents for methylated DNA and other molecular modifications.
This project brings researchers together to find ways to put effective HIV solutions into practice in the US and globally.
This project studies how failed-repair proximal tubule cells contribute to the shift from acute kidney injury to chronic kidney disease.
This project runs a shared lab that helps researchers measure molecular binding and use mass spectrometry and advanced imaging tools.
This project improves a software tool suite that predicts neoantigens for cancer immunotherapy and builds a shared collection of observed neoantigens.
This project tests whether combining checkpoint blockade with an in situ vaccine helps tumor-reactive T cells respond, using samples and an animal model.
This project builds fiber light sources with flexible pulse durations and wavelengths for nonlinear imaging of living tissue without labels.
This project studies how neuropeptides from the vgf gene change synaptic plasticity in the nucleus accumbens after oxycodone exposure and withdrawal.
This project provides statistical support for cancer research, including experimental design and data analysis for clinical trials and laboratory studies.
This project uses machine learning to analyze emergency department visits for psychiatric care and predict which patients face adverse events afterward.
This project tests whether decision support tools help patients with hereditary cancer syndromes get timely cancer prevention care from their clinicians.
This project screens zebrafish mutants to find genes and pathways that cause scoliosis and affect how the spine develops.
This project builds a computational and neurological model to understand why people keep pursuing drugs despite high costs.
This project builds a benchmarking framework that compares bioinformatic tools used to find and describe viruses.
This project studies how arenaviruses infect the placenta during pregnancy, using human placenta models and guinea pigs.
